proposals.quote: $163 million for a Community Impact Fund that will provide grants to non-profit organizations serving Queens communities and residents. Metropolitan Park will organize and operate the Fund based on recommendations of representatives of these most impacted Community Board Districts in cooperation with our local governing partners.

A seven (7) member Board will be formed that will include at least one member appointed by the Chair of Queens Community Board 3 and additional member nominations will be based on geographic proximity to the site.

The Metropolitan Park Community Impact Fund is a long-term charitable commitment designed to support organizations and programs that serve Queens residents—especially the communities surrounding Willets Point.
With $2 million in grants distributed in 2026 alone, the Community Impact Fund will provide direct, neighborhood-level investment to local nonprofits and community-based organizations.

Starting in 2026, the Fund will distribute approximately $2 million per year in grants, typically about $15,000 per organization, supporting dozens of Queens-based nonprofits annually. Funding will increase to roughly $5 million per year beginning in 2031 and continue through 2050.
The Community Impact Fund is owned and operated by Hard Rock at Metropolitan Park.
